sampleValues.Culture / People Name: The Kaelari of the Terraced Valleys
sampleValues.Ancestral Homeland & Climate: Misty highland cloud-forests and terraced slate valleys
sampleValues.Social Structure & Naming Customs: Citizens carry a birth-name until age sixteen, when they weave a personal craft-name into their cloak belt.
sampleValues.Taboos & Unforgivable Insults: Pointing a bare blade at a hearth fire or refusing a guest's first cup of cedar tea.
sampleValues.Fashion, Textiles & Adornment: Indigo-dyed wool tunics layered under rain-waxed linen mantles trimmed with brass bells.
sampleValues.Staple Cuisine & Feast Dishes: Smoked mountain trout, chestnut flatbread, and spiced plum wine served in carved horn cups.
sampleValues.Architectural Style & Craft: Stepped dry-stone lodges topped with living moss roofs and wind-chime eaves.
sampleValues.Rites of Passage & Mourning: When an elder passes, their finest handcrafted tool is hung from the village memory-oak.
